items.title: Coca Cola (KO) Keeps Raising Its Outlook After Consecutive Earnings Beats
items.summary: Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) regained a long term Marriott hotel beverage contract in 2026 after several decades without the agreement. The group is advancing an African bottling refranchising program in 2026, shifting more local production and distribution to regional partners. Management has reported consecutive earnings beats in recent quarters and has raised earnings guidance for the current financial year.
